scope: explicit local fixed-check workflow in one-shot CLI, chat and TUI; no automatic model query or queue drain
manifest_algorithm: sorted relative path + NUL + SHA256(LF-normalized bytes) hex + newline

installed_wheel.scope: new 17 regressions loaded from copied tests; every imported application module verified under installed target; final validation JSON not claimed present in this sdist

isolated_parent_finish_policy_negative.scope: current feature and frozen late-guidance test with only parent SprigApp.finished policy, patched in an isolated process; one undesired scripted query

regressions: real failed check then passed rerun, each independently approved and saved
empty checks, read-only and disabled run rejected; non-TTY approval refused
integer exit status and reliable approved result required; active jobs defer verification
intent save failure executes nothing; result save failure never reports a pass or replays the check
old pending intents closed by history validation, never executed
cancel, approval feedback and new guidance remain local until explicit continuation
one-shot CLI bypasses model credentials and default TUI without constructing Provider or SessionStore
normal chat entry persists n: feedback without executing its rejected command or querying a model
80x24 Enter flow, future queue untouched, late-guidance race, result save failure and pending recovery
three actual loopback protocols: zero requests during verify, two each on explicit repair continuation
checks: schema equals generated schema; example TOML validates
new regressions run against installed wheel
frozen functional bytes rechecked before record creation

remote_ci.resume_requires: verify account restriction and prior required gate

limits: local WSL is not native GitHub Actions evidence; platform skips are not passes
check success describes selected commands at that time, not complete requirement coverage
approved check programs can access network or outside files; no new OS sandbox guarantee
loopback replies are scripted, not live model coding-performance evidence
previous Click and diagnostic real-model results unchanged
